name: The Piston Bacon Cheddar Burger with Onion Rings
whyItWorks: Thick ground beef topped with smoked bacon strips, melted cheddar cheese, sweet BBQ sauce, and towering battered deep-fried onion rings. Heavy grease, alliums, and dairy trigger acute gut irritation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grease & Allium Warning: Avoid during flares. Order a plain grilled chicken sandwich or plain single hamburger without onion rings.
